test_title: PYST 3: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 02 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the following sentence in passive voice.**

Daddy baked the cookies on the weekend.

options.text: Daddy, on the weekend, baked cookies.
The cookies were baked on the weekend by Daddy.
On the weekend Daddy baked cookies.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The cookies were baked on the weekend by Daddy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In passive voice, the focus is on the action and the recipient of the action rather than the person or thing performing the action.
